43. De Bile flava & atra, item de Veficula fellis & Liene.

page.notes: The line numbers are printed as "ʃ" style long-s-like figures for 50 to 56 (s-shaped 5); transcribed here as 50 to 56. Item 36 is printed "Menstruo" followed by a line break and "generationis principiis," and the hyphen-like flourish after "Menstruo" is a printed mark, not a hyphen. The closing line is set in italic. The bottom word "OTHO-" is a catchword/signature-style fragment at the foot, cut off by the page edge; it is kept as printed. Faint show-through text from the reverse page is ignored.
